name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MBChB)
notes: Sub-minimum APS 450/600 (English + Maths + Physical Sciences + next 3 best, LO excluded) (this is the app's minimum). Final selection uses the Health FPS out of 900, which adds NBT scores. Also needs the next three best subjects (excluding LO) at 70% each. Band A (guaranteed): FPS 810+/900 and NBT Proficient for AL, QL and Mathematics. Band B (likely): WPS 807+ and NBT Intermediate or above for AL, QL and Mathematics. Band C (possible, SA redress categories only): FPS 644+ and NBT Intermediate or above for all three. 240 places. Followed by 2-year internship and 1 year community service (HPCSA). SADC eligibility (MBChB): Comoros, Eswatini, Lesotho, Seychelles only. Applicants must be SA citizens/permanent residents or from listed SADC countries. First-choice applicants prioritised. NBTs must be written by 31 Jul 2026 to be considered for a conditional offer (final NBT date 3 Oct 2026).

name: Bachelor of Science in Physiotherapy
notes: Sub-minimum APS 360/600 (this is the app's minimum). Final selection uses the Health FPS out of 900, which adds NBT scores. Also needs the next three best subjects (excluding LO) at 60% each. Mathematical Literacy not listed. Band A (guaranteed): FPS 730+/900. Band B (likely): WPS 797+. Band C (possible, SA redress only): FPS 580+ (redress 1), 610+ (redress 2), 680+ (redress 3 and 4). All bands: NBT Intermediate or above for AL, QL and Mathematics. Prospectus FPS formula names Physical Sciences; Life Sciences accepted as the science subject. 70 places. Followed by 1 year community service. SADC eligibility (Physiotherapy): Angola, Eswatini, Lesotho. Applicants must be SA citizens/permanent residents or from listed SADC countries. First-choice applicants prioritised. NBTs must be written by 31 Jul 2026 to be considered for a conditional offer (final NBT date 3 Oct 2026).

name: Bachelor of Science in Occupational Therapy
notes: Sub-minimum APS 340/600 (this is the app's minimum). Final selection uses the Health FPS out of 900, which adds NBT scores. Also needs the next three best subjects (excluding LO) at 60% each. Band A (guaranteed): FPS 730+/900. Band B (likely): WPS 782+. Band C (possible, SA redress only): FPS 565 (redress 1), 580 (redress 2), 670 (redress 3 and 4). NBTs must be written by 31 Jul 2026 to be considered for a conditional offer (final NBT date 3 Oct 2026).

name: Higher Certificate in Disability Practice
notes: Admission not expressed in bands or points. Requires an NSC (or approved HEQSF level 4 school-leaving qualification) and NBT Academic and Quantitative Literacy at Upper Intermediate to Proficient (NBT Mathematics not required). No subject percentages printed (no English % printed). Aimed at home-based carers and school-leavers interested in community-based disability practice. 1 year full-time with work-integrated learning. 30 places; offered only if there are enough applicants.
